# Version 3.0.0
> **Major-version preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.0.0-preview.5.4)

> **Superseded by [3.116.0](3.116.0.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 3.116.0.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.0.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.0.0 preview modernizes the binding and platform surface for the next major release. The preview brings current Skia and HarfBuzz foundations, .NET 9 support, and broad view-layer compatibility work.

## Breaking Changes

- **Obsolete APIs removed** — APIs that were previously marked obsolete have been removed for the major-version transition. Rebuild your application and replace each obsolete member with its documented modern alternative.

## Platform

- **.NET 9 and modern desktop controls supported** — Updates the target-platform integration for current .NET releases and the newer WinForms GL control packages. — ❤️ [@maxkatz6](https://github.com/maxkatz6) ([#2917](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2917), [#2971](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2971))

## Engine

- **Skia and HarfBuzz foundations updated** — Refreshes the native graphics and text-shaping components for the v3 preview line. ([#2505](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2505), [#2539](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2539), [#2582](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2582), [#2730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2730))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.0

Updates HarfBuzzSharp for the v3 preview line with current text-shaping support.
